inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read This Transit in Your Timing
inline.titleEn: Five Steps to Read Your Saturn Return Career Timing
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence: locate natal Saturn, check return period, name work structure, compare promises with capacity, track repeated questions

items.subEn: Note its house, sign, and close aspects — the house often names the life area where responsibility is emphasized
Look for Saturn nearing, crossing, or revisiting its natal degree, including retrograde passes
List the title, schedule, pay arrangement, authority level, and expectations that currently define the role
Notice where a commitment asks for skills, limits, or decisions that have not yet been made explicit
Pay attention when the same concern returns around training, management, self-employment, or leaving an unsustainable arrangement

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## This Career Passage at a Glance
inline.titleEn: Saturn Return Career Passage at a Glance
inline.altEn: Three-column comparison: what Saturn return tracks, what it reveals about career tension, and what it cannot do as an interpretive tool

linesEn: Saturn returns to its natal degree, typically around ages 29 and 58
Unfolds through several passes including retrograde periods
Work duties, authority patterns, and long-term vocational commitments
Where promises need firmer terms or clearer revision
Cannot predict a required external event or career outcome
Cannot replace budget, contract, or real-world workplace context
